senses.gloss: निधान- + उष्मन् निधान- + उष्मन्, m. ardour, courage, caused by the possession of a treasure, Pañc. 118, 15.

निधन निधन, i. e. perhaps नि-हन् + अ, n.
 1. Conclusion, end, MBh. 1, 4612; Suśr. 1, 18, 19.
 2. Annihilation, Bhartṛ. 2, 13.
 3. Death, Man. 5, 40.

निधान निधान, i. e. नि-धा + अन, n. (m., Rām. 5, 11, 4),
 1. Putting aside, MBh. 4, 158.
 2. A receptacle, a place or vessel in or on which anything is collected or deposited, Hariv. 2477.
 3. A treasure, Man. 8, 36.
 --Comp.
निधनता निधनता, i. e. नि-धन + ता, f. Poverty, Hit. i. d. 128 (cf. निर्-धनता).

निधि निधि, i. e. नि-धा (cf. धि and पयोधि), m.
 1. A receptacle, MBh. 1, 1124.
 2. A treasure, Man. 7, 82.
 --Comp.
निधिप निधि-प (vb. 2. पा), m. The guardian of a treasure, Man. 2, 115.
निधुवन निधुवन, i. e. नि-धू + अन, n. Sexual intercourse, Rājat. 5, 285.
निधि- + पति निधि- + पति, m. 1. a name of Kuvera. 2. a proper name.
